window: First 252 officially open market sessions on or after first_eligible_date. For a prospective label, evidence of collection must follow rule registration. Official closures are not sessions. Missing instrument bars and halts do not extend the window. Capture may be incomplete; no successful capture is asserted by this file.
candidate: lead5 with threshold 0.01, the frozen run_research.make_rule
benchmark: frozen baseline rebound; cash and 10%-cap buy-and-hold as descriptive controls
start_state: Flat with IRR 100000000, preceding valid observations warm features
input_gate: Dated exchange session calendar and symbol states; corporate action/time and raw vs adjusted; documented effective costs and coverage; dual-source or integrity/provenance check for closing and FIRST; no unknown gaps resolved by forward fill
evaluation: One evaluation after window and evidence are sealed; early diagnostic data missingness only. Failure stops promotion. No parameter change on this window. No live execution.
